 1                                            NOTICE OF MOTION
 2          Plaintiff Apple, Inc. (“Apple” or “Plaintiff”) will, and hereby does, under Rule 65 of the Federal
 3   Rules of Civil Procedure and Local Rule 65-1, apply ex parte for a Temporary Restraining Order and
 4   Order to Show Cause as set forth below, and respectfully requests that this matter be heard in Courtroom
 5   5, 4th Floor of the above-entitled Court, located at 280 South 1st Street, San Jose, CA 95113, before the
 6   Honorable Nathanael M. Cousins as soon as practical.
 7          Apple seeks the following relief:
 8          (1) a Temporary Restraining Order (“TRO”) against Defendants Guangdong Oppo Mobile
 9   Telecommunications Corp., Ltd. and InnoPeak Technology Inc. (collectively “OPPO Defendants”), and
10   Chen Shi (collectively, “Defendants”) (a) enjoining Defendants from disclosing, retaining, or using any
11   Apple confidential information or trade secrets; (b) requiring Defendants to preserve all documents, data,
12   devices, communications, and other evidence potentially relevant to the facts and circumstances of this
13   case; and (c) requiring the immediate return to Apple, through Apple’s undersigned counsel, of all Apple
14   confidential information and trade secrets in their possession, custody, or control;
15          (2) an order to show cause why a preliminary injunction should not issue; and
16          (3) an order permitting Apple to take expedited discovery in aid of its request for a preliminary
17   injunction to reveal the full extent and mode of Defendants’ misconduct and to assess the risk of additional,
18   still-unknown irreparable harm.
19          This motion is supported by Apple’s Complaint (Dkt. 1), the accompanying Memorandum of
20   Points and Authorities, the Declaration of Laura Vartain Horn and supporting exhibits, the Declaration of
21   Daniel Roffman and supporting appendices, the Declaration of Mathieu Charbonneau-Lefort, Ph.D. and
22   supporting exhibits, the Declaration of James Clements and supporting exhibits, the Declaration of Daniel
23   Brody, and the proposed Temporary Restraining Order, Expedited Discovery, and Order to Show Cause.
24          Apple’s motion is made pursuant to Federal Rules of Civil Procedure 26(d), 30(a), 33(b), 34(b),
25   and 65, this Court’s Civil Local Rules, and the Court’s inherent power to control the litigation before it,
26   particularly to serve the interests of equity and judicial economy.
27          Apple provided notice to Defendants that it intended to seek expedited injunctive relief to stop the
28   misappropriation of its trade secrets, as well as of its Complaint. On August 21, 2025, Apple emailed the
